question: Do parity-preserving trained position labels redirect content-addressed retrieval to the specifically implied value?
primary: All nine derangements, paired with their coherent slot-permutation controls; every condition and seed must meet point thresholds.

bootstrap.unit: dictionary row; stratified within each of four query positions
bootstrap.pairing: same row weights across all conditions and all six seeds
bootstrap.aggregation: equal weight over nine derangements within each row before resampling

forecast_scope: All 50 conditions, with controls and native-grouped references separately identified. Numeric adequacy is reported separately from mechanistic gates.
claim_scope: Causal control of binding by externally assigned positional coordinates in six existing tiny trained models. Does not establish spontaneous layout transfer, unique internal algorithm, or novelty over all literature.
stopping: Run the whole fixed grid once after public registration, retain every failure, and report all gates. No new maps, model selection or threshold changes after outcomes. Follow-up discoveries need a separately registered test.
